Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		overdueUsers: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.SuspensionDays>0),
		overdueBooks: Set(Book) = Book.allInstance()->select(b|b.Copys->exists(c|c.Status = 'LOANED' and
		c.LoanedRecord->exists(l|l.ReturnedUser = u)))
	precondition:
		overdueUsers.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		overdueUsers->forAll(u|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays-1) and
		overdueUsers->forAll(u|if u.SuspensionDays = 0 
		then u.BorrowStatus = 'SUSPEND' 
		else true 
		endif )
}
